findings.criterion: [operator-attested] a real gate run with classes configured across two providers records the per-pass model ids actually used, cited from the run's usage log in a comment
findings.detail: No ticket comment contains an attestation of a real gate run with classes configured across two providers. The four comments on ticket eb58-e71d-ec90-4b00 are all plan corrections and mechanism decisions (PLAN REVIEW #1 remediation, keystone decision, and two corrections to the keystone decision). None records a gate run, per-pass model ids, or a usage log citation. The operator-attested criterion requires a concrete attestation naming ≥1 verifiable specific (a run reference, observed log line, or measured outcome) — none is present.
findings.remediation: Record a real gate run with classes configured across two providers (e.g., Anthropic for one class, Bedrock for another) as a ticket comment. The comment must cite the run's usage log (a specific log path, run id, or log excerpt) showing the per-pass model ids actually used, and name when the run occurred.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
